clauses.instruction: Acquire the authorized facilities mock data scan results in the operator-canonical sandbox scope.
Project the concrete target records reported by the facilities scan.
Count the concrete target records needing review for the requested summary.
Summarize the concrete facilities targets needing review, including the acquired target details and their count, without adding any unacquired targets.
